product_one_liner.value: Incorta is a governed data and AI platform for enterprise teams that connects live operational data to analytics, AI agents, applications, and workflows.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link appears in the navigation or footer, and /pricing returns Page Not Found.

named_customers.notes: Both have customer stories on Incorta's website.

eng_blog.notes: Engineering@Incorta includes technical posts on OpenCopilot agent design and Incorta's query/index architecture.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes getting-started guides, connector concepts, data-source topics, and release documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Senior AI/ML Engineer in Cairo; the posting includes an application link.

model_provider.notes: Presented as model options; the homepage explicitly describes building enterprise AI apps with Claude.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims an annually updated SOC 2 Type II report and GDPR compliance; GDPR is not a formal certification.

last_funding.notes: Date disputed: PitchBook lists a completed $120M Series D dated April 24, 2025, while Incorta's own $120M Series D announcement is dated June 23, 2021.

raised_18mo.notes: Both reported funding dates—April 2025 and June 2021—precede the May 9, 2025 start of the requested window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Enterprise Account Executive – BFSI in Riyadh.

launched_6mo.notes: On September 30, 2026, Incorta announced AI-assisted data transformation capabilities, including AI Workflow Assistant.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Omar Hajsaleh's profile lists his start as Vice President of Sales EMEA in December 2025.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Sales and marketing job postings name these systems; the marketing role specifically requires integration experience.
